blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A 65-year-old woman died after refusing to leave her burning house in Sariaya town, Quezon province, on Sunday, police said. The Quezon police said in a report Monday that a male relative noticed the house on fire in Barangay Lutucan Bata and rushed inside to rescue the woman, who was reportedly suffering from an unspecified mental health condition. READ: Surigao del Norte forest fire threatened PH eagle nests The woman, however, refused to leave the house, forcing the relative to abandon the rescue attempt because of the intense heat, police said.
